title: lomatium lucidum
intro: Lomatium lucidum, commonly known as Lomatium or Desert Biscuit Root, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the western regions of North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include immune system support, anti-inflammatory properties, and antimicrobial action, making it a popular choice for natural remedies. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium lucidum include expectorant and anti-tussive properties, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Lomatium lucidum include furanocoumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, along with other compounds like sesquiterpenes and alkaloids.
